answer: Make admission a cargo dock, not a free mailbox. An applicant may mine only after booking one exclusive slip at a monitored wharf and posting a deposit that vests over two quiet epochs. Copies cannot stack in the same slip, and a prism of berth clocks plus packet fingerprints will show when many names move as one fleet. The lotus mark on that slip is then burned, and the dock stays closed to that operator for a season, so farms buy scarce berths instead of cheap keys.
